description: This is a false-colour satellite image showing a large, dark blue lake encircled by diverse land cover. The surrounding land displays a mosaic of distinct agricultural parcels and other vegetation, rendered in various shades of green, yellow, orange, brown, red, and purple, characteristic of Earth Observation data. Three prominent yellow arrows point to specific agricultural fields that appear lighter green/yellowish: one on the western side of the lake, one on the eastern side, and one on the southern side. The land use patterns show a predominance of geometric parcels, indicative of managed agricultural areas, interspersed with less structured patches of vegetation. No scale bar, compass, legend, or reference year is visible on the image.
